role: The single source of truth for how every image in this project looks. The print desk compiles a prompt from it (src/look/compile.mjs) and feeds that prompt + the reference photo to FLUX.2 [klein] 4B. Nothing visual ships that was not drawn from this file.

city.name: Bahía Rosa
city.note: Invented coastal city. Never name, depict, or imply a real game location, studio, or franchise.

punch: Keep the person in the reference photo exactly as they are — same face, hair, glasses, age — and restyle everything around them as the lead of a current-generation open-world crime game: waist-up, the city filling the frame around them.

compliance.note: The challenge requires original visuals only: no third-party assets, no leaked material, no trademarks. These rules are enforced in code, not just intent — see assertSafe() in src/look/compile.mjs.
compliance.promptTail: Original fan-made artwork, invented city, no franchise marks, no text, no watermark.
compliance.disclaimer: Unofficial fan-made project for the Unlayer Build with React Image Editor Challenge. Not affiliated with, endorsed by, or connected to Rockstar Games or Take-Two Interactive.

identity.note: The person must survive the restyle. A plate that loses the face is a failed plate, no matter how pretty. Rules are kept to three short clauses on purpose: a 4B distilled model reads the first ~200 characters carefully and everything after that loosely, so the identity sentence leads and the rest decorates.
rules: Same face: identical face shape, jawline, brow, nose and mouth proportions.
Same hair, glasses, skin tone, marks and expression.
forbidden: change apparent age or gender presentation
add jewellery, tattoos or makeup not in the photo
identity.longFormNote: Fuller intent that used to be compiled into the prompt: keep hair length, hairline and how it falls; keep frame shape and lens thickness of glasses; keep moles, freckles, stubble, scars; do not straighten the pose; no extra figures, hands, or duplicated features.

registers.note: A register is the medium the plate is rendered in. Surfaces pick a register; the register picks a default lighting and palette.

character-shot.label: Character shot
character-shot.use: The default conversion: your photo restyled as a current-generation open-world character portrait standing in the city.
character-shot.medium: Photoreal in-engine character portrait from a current-generation open-world crime game: ray-traced global illumination, subsurface-scattered skin, strand-level hair, pores and stubble visible.
character-shot.background: The invented coastal city at golden hour: palm fronds catching the sun, pastel Art Deco facades, chrome trim, a receding boulevard falling out of focus.
character-shot.finish: Cinematic grade: warm highlights against teal shadow, natural skin tones, soft bloom on specular edges, wet-surface reflections, fine film grain.
character-shot.backgroundNote: Design intent, not compiled: heat haze on a distant skyline, plate glass, palms reading as dark shapes past the frame edge.

key-art.label: Key art
key-art.use: Loading screen. The illustrated portrait the city opens with.
key-art.medium: Hand-painted cel-shaded character key art for a high-fidelity open-world crime drama: confident bold ink linework, flat blocked colour, single hard shadow tone, warm graphic skin, poster-grade composition.
key-art.background: Completely flat solid deep-maroon field with a few thin white line-art landmarks drawn behind the subject at low opacity; clean, untextured, evenly lit.
key-art.finish: Crisp vector-like edges, no photographic grain, no bloom, no lens artefacts.

press-photo.label: Press photo
press-photo.use: Front page. The photoreal editorial shot the tabloid runs.
press-photo.medium: Photoreal in-engine photograph from a current-generation open-world title: physically based materials, ray-traced reflections, wet surfaces, believable skin with subsurface scattering.
press-photo.background: The invented coastal city at street level: sun-bleached stucco, faded signage, palm shadow, tropical humidity in the air.
press-photo.finish: 50mm at f/2.0, shallow depth of field on the eyes, clean highlight rolloff, subtle grain, no interface overlays, no on-screen readouts.

neon-night.label: Neon night
neon-night.medium: Photoreal night photograph of the invented city: saturated LED signage, streetlight bloom with visible light cones, city glow on the horizon, standing water on tarmac doubling every light source.
neon-night.background: Wet asphalt, brushed steel, plate glass, chrome trim, palm silhouettes as dark cut-outs.
neon-night.finish: 35mm at f/1.8, wet-night reflections, deep blacks that keep detail, controlled magenta-and-cyan highlights, fine grain.

loading-screen.label: Loading screen
loading-screen.use: The classic loading-screen panel: the character inside a painted scene, with the bottom quarter left clean so the player types their own name into it with the editor's text tool.
loading-screen.medium: Hand-painted loading-screen illustration for a high-fidelity open-world crime drama: confident brushwork over cel-shaded form, painted sky and water, simplified but readable city detail, an ink-clean edge on the figure.
loading-screen.background: A painted wide city scene behind the character — boulevard, palms and deco facades under a big sky — rendered as illustration rather than photograph.
loading-screen.finish: Poster-grade painted panel, high contrast, no photographic grain; the bottom quarter of the frame is calm and uncluttered, empty of detail and free of any lettering.

lighting.dual-rim: warm amber key light from one side and a soft cool cyan rim from the other, raking hair, ear, jaw and shoulder; the face itself stays naturally lit and skin-coloured, never bathed in coloured light.
lighting.studio-flat: Even, soft, directionless studio light on the subject; no visible light source; no cast shadow on the field.
lighting.golden-hour-coastal: Late-afternoon subtropical sun at a low angle: warm amber key, long soft shadows, humidity haze, gentle bounce from pale walls.
lighting.midday-haze: High sun through humidity: slightly blown highlights on white surfaces, washed-out colour, heat shimmer on distant edges, hard short shadows.
lighting.overcast-blue-grey: Flat blue-grey overcast daylight: no direct sun, soft shadows, muted saturation, a cool cast that reads as real weather rather than a filter.
lighting.dusk-neon: Dusk into night: magenta and cyan signage as the dominant sources, warm interior spill from doorways, cool ambient sky overhead, strong specular highlights on wet ground.
lighting.interior-neon-club: Low-key interior: hard coloured practicals, smoke in the air, deep unlit background, faces lit by a nearby coloured source.

deco-pastel.description: Tropical Art Deco pastels: soft pink, sky blue, pale lemon, lavender, off-white stucco.

bleached-day.description: Sun-bleached coastal daylight: chalky white walls, pale turquoise water, warm sand, faded teal signage.

neon-wet.description: pink-and-teal sunset running into hot magenta signage, electric cyan, amber sodium accents, deep blue-black shadow.

cinematic-warm.description: naturalistic cinematic colour: sun-warmed skin that stays skin-coloured, amber and gold highlights, teal shadow, deep blue-black depth, no magenta cast on faces.

warm-dusk.description: Amber dusk: burnt orange sky, dusty rose clouds, violet shadow, warm rim light.

scenery: palm-lined boulevard, pastel Art Deco facades with chrome trim, neon shopfront signs, plate glass, a marina of masts behind, a ferris wheel on the pier, sunset sky streaked with warm cloud, haze between buildings, soft bokeh of passing traffic.

locations.note: Where the subject is standing. One photo should not always print the same street, so the desk rotates through these unless a location is named. Each entry overrides the scenery clause.

boulevard.label: Palm boulevard
boulevard.scenery: palm-lined boulevard at golden hour, pastel deco facades, chrome trim, shopfront glass, long shadows raking across the asphalt.

marina.label: Marina pier
marina.scenery: waterfront promenade, yacht masts, a ferris wheel turning on the pier, moored hulls, warm dock lights coming on.

downtown.label: Downtown canyon
downtown.scenery: downtown street canyon, glass towers stacked against a bright sky, neon shopfronts, traffic lights and thin light trails.

rooftop.label: Rooftop
rooftop.scenery: rooftop terrace above the city, water tanks and aerials, the skyline glowing behind, deep dusk sky above.

market.label: Night market
market.scenery: night market street, striped awnings, string lights, food stalls, crowd bokeh and warm cooking smoke.

seafront.label: Seafront road
seafront.scenery: coastal road along a seawall, ocean haze, mooring bollards, gulls, the sun low over the water.

hillside.label: Hillside overlook
hillside.scenery: hillside overlook above the city, a switchback road behind, the whole city glittering below through warm haze.

camera.framing: Waist-up, subject on the left third, the city filling the rest of the frame.
camera.focus: Eyes tack sharp, background soft but readable.
camera.rimLight: Both rims legible on hair, jaw and shoulder — bright, not blown.
camera.post: No vignette, no tilt-shift, no HDR halos.

world.note: Original vocabulary only. These are shapes and textures, never named products, brands, or franchise locations.

render.seedPolicy: random by default; every produced plate records its seed and spec version in the filename and manifest
render.identityStrength: preserve the reference photo's subject; do not invent a new face
render.guidanceNote: klein is a distilled 4-step model: it runs at guidance 1.0 (no classifier-free guidance). Raising this does not add detail — it burns the image and wrecks the lighting. Cloudflare's own copy of this model and ComfyUI's official template both run cfg 1.
render.promptNote: A 4B distilled model follows the first ~200 characters closely and the rest loosely, so the prompt leads with the punch line + identity, and everything after that is decoration. Keep compiled prompts under the promptBudget; tests enforce it.
render.resolutionNote: klein 4B is happiest at 1K; keep input reference images under 512px per side as the model requires.

debut.brief: the subject standing in the city at golden hour

loading.brief: clean grade, subject centred, name plate clear

loadingscreen.brief: the subject painted into the city, bottom quarter calm and clear of detail

frontpage.brief: face above the fold, masthead clear, tabloid drama

poster.brief: sell the room; the subject as the night's draw
